title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #2 OPERATION BLADE OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #2 OPERATION BLADE OPEN
SEASON BEGINS: February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
SEASON ENDS: February 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different “Contracts” to clear the stage. Complete certain strategies, improve level evaluation, and collect “Contract Bounty” and “Operation Agreement”.
“Contract Bounty” can be used to redeem rewards in “Secret Sanctuary”.
“Operation Agreement” can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON “ SECRET SANCTUARY” OPEN
Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
★★★★★: Scene
Scene's Token
Vitafield[Rewilder] Series Classics - Bitter Herbs for Myrrh
Season #2 Furniture - Blade Pennant
Season #2 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Part, Battle Record, Chips, etc.
DURATION: February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
TRAINING GROUNDS SEASON #2 SITES OPEN
During Season #2, Training Ground provides all Rotating Sites from current season.
The Unlock Rank of daily Rotating Sites can be raised at the same time by clearing them in Training Ground.
Raising the Unlock Rank in Training Ground for the first time can obtain Unlock Rewards. (Contract Bounty, Rhodes Island Supplies.)
NOTE
You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
You need to complete certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some Contracts. The number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency level.

Compared with Season #1, Season #2 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 1 stie from the previous Season with a brand new one. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The site’s rotation time and the challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
Several new Contracts will be added to the Season’s Permanent Site on February 11, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7).
After Season #2 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
After Season #2 ends, the Operation Agreement you collected will be automatically converted into Operation Blade Supplies, the ratio is 1:1.
During Season #2, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
During Season #2, players can obtain Season #2 Medal set by achieving related goals.

DURATION: February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the special Headhunting, “Joint Operation”, opens and ONLY these following Operators will appear from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Blaze / Saria / Mostima / Hellagur
★★★★★: Nearl / Firewatch / GreyThroat / Hung / Executor / Glaucus

DURATION: February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
04 CORAL COAST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Shimmering Dew SD01 for Nearl
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA008 for Rope
05 NEW LUCKY DROP THEMED FURNITURE SET - RHODES ISLAND HR OFFICE
UPDATE TIME: February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DROP FURNITURE: Rhodes Island HR Office
HOW TO COLLECT: Lucky drop on every stage of Main Storyline Episode 1-7 (excluding Challenge Mode and Training Mission) and every stage in Supplies.
DETAILS:

New lucky drop furniture set Rhodes Island HR Office will replace the current lucky drop furniture set Reimselar Ballroom. After the replacement, Reimselar Ballroom themed furniture set will be available at the Store.
NOTE:
Reimselar Ballroom will be available at the Store after February 4, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7).
06 EXCLUSIVE LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: February 13, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) - February 23, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 0-11
DETAILS: During the event, players can login for 7 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Bunny Pestle and Mortar * 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2
Day 2: Originite Prime * 1, Pure Gold * 20
Day 3: Orundum * 200, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 4: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 2, Chip Catalyst * 1
Day 5: Orundum * 200, LMD * 30000
Day 6: Relaxing Rocking Chair * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 7: Headhunting Permit * 1, Furniture Part * 100
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potions from this event will be expired on March 1, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
